name: Saljook Haider
headline: Security Operations · Incident Response
summary: I'm a SOC-focused cyber security analyst. For two years I triaged Splunk alerts, investigated endpoint, identity and email threats, and escalated confirmed incidents.
I hold BTL1 (Gold) and CompTIA Security+, and a First Class MSc in Cybersecurity. Before security I was a frontend developer, so I like automating the boring parts with Python and PowerShell.
Looking for my next SOC or incident response role. If you're hiring, or just want to talk detections, say hello.

now.text: Open to SOC analyst and incident response roles in Dublin or remote. Building this site in public.

highlights: Triaged 200+ Splunk alerts a week, correlating system, network and endpoint logs
Escalated 40+ confirmed incidents and supported containment: account disablement, host isolation, IP/domain blocks
Analysed 50+ reported phishing emails a month, extracting and enriching IOCs
Tuned detections to cut false positives by 30%; automated triage with Python and PowerShell, saving ~8 hours a week

experience.summary: Secure web solutions, remote from Germany.
highlights: Found and fixed input validation failures and access misconfigurations in live client sites
Explained security risk to non-technical clients in Germany, Switzerland and Austria
